answer: Every new identity pays a non-refundable sybil tax. The agent seals its key with a fresh cipher, tends a willow for one season, and carves its identity hash into a basalt slab. Living growth is a time anchor no money can fast-forward. Cost: 40 for the cipher, 120 for the willow, 90 for the carving — 250 per identity, 250,000 for a thousand fakes. Honest agents pay once, then earn every epoch, undiluted, because fakes cannot afford the tax.
